# Windows: setup-cli.exe answers for the hub node, one per line, in the order of the prompts.
# Format: see feed_answers.py. <enter> = accept default, <clear>x = replace the default with x,
# ${VAR} from the workflow env, menus take the option number (1-based).
# The same prompts as the Linux answers (../linux), but the end: on Windows setup-cli.exe asks to
# install the Windows services (synodepy3 winsrv.install_winsrvs(), since 9e3843b). The runner is
# already elevated, so no UAC request.
# Volume paths must use '/', not '\' (setup-cli.exe rejects '\').
#
# The central snapshot (alpha-central-0.1.8) has the domains closed-1 and closed-2 of org
# closed-test. The hub creates the domain ${CENTRAL_DOMAIN} (ci-0.8), for which the central plans
# 3 synodes in state create (c): ci-0.8-hub, ci-0.8-1, ci-0.8-2. The hub takes ci-0.8-hub.
# If the central's menus change order, the workflow reports the mismatched domain / synode id.

<clear>${CENTRAL_URL}     # Please input central service url. Value from yml file
<enter>                   # Portfolio 0.8.0 market ID: alpha. Return to continue ...
3                         # Please select a domain: 1 = closed-1, 2 = closed-2, 3 = Create a new domain...
${CENTRAL_DOMAIN}         # Please input new domain name: ci-0.8
1                         # Please select a Synode: 1 = ci-0.8-hub (the central lists the hub first)
<enter>                   # Set volume path: default ./vol
1                         # Synode mode: 1 = Domain Hub / Centre, 2 = Primary Storage Node
<clear>8951:8961          # Ports "www-port:synode-service"
2                         # Mapped to a public address / reverse proxy? 2 = No
1                         # All settings are collected, install? 1 = Yes
<enter>                   # Domain token of user Admin: the packaged default (tasks.*.json deploy.domain_token)
1                         # Install the Windows services now? 1 = Yes (synode & web services)
2                         # <services>: installed ... Start Portfolio Desktop now? 2 = No, quit
                          # (older packages, or no desktop/: Return to quit Portfolio Setup, '2' ignored)
